index.guidance:
Rich text is a list of segments: { text, marks? } or { embed, marks? }. A plain string is plain text, HTML tags included.
Marks: bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, code, sup, sub, highlight, color, background, link, and tag:<name> for a custom inline tool. sup and sub cannot share a run.
highlight alone is stored as background "yellow"; with a background, as that background. color and background take a preset: "gray", "brown", "orange", "yellow", "green", "blue", "purple", "pink", "red". Hex, rgb and hsl are stored as the nearest preset. A CSS colour name is lowercased and kept, and so is var(--name). Other syntaxes (oklch, lab, hwb, color()) are dropped, as are a transparent colour and a white or dark-grey page background.
A link needs href. With no target or rel it gets target "_blank" and rel "nofollow"; an "#anchor" href gets target "_self". A target or rel you give is kept, but in the editor a host link config replaces both.
Embeds: { equation: { expression } } is inline LaTeX; { page: { id } } mentions a page: id is the pageId in a page block's data, not the block id.
text.format with unset ["*"] clears every mark; "tag:*" clears every custom mark.
markdown.insert cannot write underline, sup, sub, highlight or colours: insert the text, then use text.format.

command.name: block.insert
command.summary: Insert a block, with optional children.
command.guidance: Rich-text fields take segments or plain text, never Markdown. Use markdown.insert for Markdown.

A variant sets these data fields; the tool's other required fields still go in data: header {level: 1|2|3|4|5|6, isToggleable: true}, list {style: "unordered"|"ordered"|"checklist"}.

tool.name: image
tool.title: Image
tool.summary: An image with optional caption, crop, turn, colour look and drawings.
tool.guidance: Insert it with url set, or upload a file with image.uploadFile where the host allows it; replace the picture with image.setSource, which also copies it to the host. Crop, rotate, flip and straighten with image.crop, image.rotate, image.flip and image.straighten: each also turns crop and markup. Add or change drawings with image.addMarkup, image.updateMarkup and image.removeMarkup. caption and alt are plain text.

variants.description: Every rendition, best format first. Ignored unless it contains `url`, the most compatible one.

naturalWidth.description: Intrinsic pixel width, cached after first load.

crop.description: Non-destructive crop, in percent of the intrinsic image. Omitted for an uncropped rectangle. With `rotation`, `flipX` or `straighten` set, it is in percent of the turned image's box.

rotation.description: Clockwise quarter turn, applied after the mirror. Omitted for 0.

flipX.description: Mirror left to right, before the turn. Omitted for false.

straighten.description: Clockwise degrees, after the turn. Omitted for 0.

filter.description: Colour look: a built-in preset (vivid, noir, sepia, …) or a host filter name from the image tool's `filters` config. Omitted for "none".

filterStrength.description: How strongly `filter` applies. Omitted for 100 and when there is no filter.

adjust.description: Colour adjustments, each -100..100. Zero entries are omitted, and so is an empty object.

markup.description: Drawings, shapes and text over the image, back to front. Omitted when empty. Coordinates are fractions (0..1) of the turned image's box, before crop and straighten. Sizes are fractions of that box's shorter side.

points.description: Flat x, y, pressure triples. Pressure is 0..1.

cut.description: Ends the eraser cut. Omitted when none.

anyOf.description: A shape between two corners. Rect and ellipse fill the box they span; line and arrow join the points.

commands.name: image.uploadFile
commands.summary: Upload a file and insert it as an image block, as a person's upload does.
commands.guidance: Pass the bytes as base64 data with a fileName, or a path when the host reads local files. The file name's extension sets the type. The host's type and size limits apply. To replace a block's file, upload a new block and delete the old one.

data.description: The file's bytes as standard base64. Not with path.

path.description: A file the host lets the agent read, relative to its upload folder. Not with data.

fileName.description: Needed with data. Defaults to the path's name.

mimeType.description: Optional. Must match the type the file name's extension gives.

parentId.description: Parent block id. Omit or null for the document root.

position.description: Where the new block goes among its siblings. Default: the end.

preconditions: Send it alone in its batch.

cases.name: execute: a big batch, 300 inserts of 2000 characters each, is applied and saved
open: without a source a stored open is SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE

error.message: No document source is configured. Start blok-mcp with --source.
